sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct State‑of‑the‑art vision‑language model capable of understanding images and generating text responses. Qwen2.5‑VL‑7B‑Instruct is a multimodal vision‑language model with 7 billion parameters that can process both images and text, enabling visual question answering, image description, and other vision‑language tasks.
